plugin.name: aurorae
plugin._long: Window decorations from KDE Aurorae SVG themes. Replaces the "decoration" plugin; enable only one of the two.

option.name: theme
option._long: Name of an Aurorae theme in ~/.local/share/aurorae/themes or /usr/share/aurorae/themes, or the path of a theme directory. Empty: the theme KWin uses (kwinrc), else the first installed one.

option.name: border_size
option._long: KDE's border size setting: none, no_sides, tiny, normal, large, very_large, huge, very_huge, oversized. "theme" uses the theme's borders unclamped.

option.name: button_size
option._long: KDE's button size setting: tiny, normal, large, very_large, huge, very_huge, oversized.

option.name: buttons_left
option._long: KDE button layout letters: M menu, S on all workspaces, F keep above, I minimize, A maximize, X close, _ spacer.

option.name: buttons_right
option._long: KDE button layout letters, see "Buttons on the left".

option.name: font
option._long: Pango font description, e.g. "Noto Sans Bold 10". Empty: KDE's title bar font from kdeglobals, else Noto Sans 10.

option.name: legacy_text_shadow
option._long: Draw the title text shadow some older themes define (UseTextShadow). Current KWin ignores it.

option.name: extended_resize_border
option._long: Width in pixels of the invisible resize area above the title bar (and around the window when the border size is none or no_sides), like KWin.

option.name: ignore_views
option._long: Windows matching these criteria are never decorated.

option.name: forced_views
option._long: Windows matching these criteria are decorated even if they draw their own decorations.
